Run the Whole Analysis Pipeline

Source: R/run_pipeline.R
run_pipeline.Rd

Run prep_visits(), clean_weight(), calc_adg(), calc_adfi() and calc_fcr() in a row with the same QC settings.

run_pipeline(
  data,
  station = NULL,
  qc = qc_config(),
  breeds = NULL,
  verbose = 1,
  cores = 1
)

Arguments

data

Raw station data (see prep_visits()).

station

"nedap", "fire" or NULL to detect it.

qc

QC settings from qc_config().

breeds

Optional breed table passed to add_breed() (columns responder and breed).

verbose

0 (silent), 1 (summary, default) or 2 (details).

cores

Number of CPU cores for the per-pig computations. Default 1.

Value

An object of class ppt_pipeline: a list with visits, weight, adg, adfi and fcr, plus removed (every pig removed, with the step and the reason). Printing it shows a summary box. With verbose >= 1 the steps are numbered with their run time, the box is shown at the end and the result is returned invisibly.

Examples

res <- run_pipeline(fire, qc = qc_config(stage_range = c(60, 120)), verbose = 0)
res
